_comment: Customer characters for the coffee game (public/coffee-game/). Generate with: npm run tripo:characters — outputs to public/models/characters/<id>.glb, which the game auto-loads (falling back to the built-in chibi peeps when a file is missing). Keep each model a single standing full-body character; the game scales it to ~1 unit tall and animates the whole body (bob/spin/stomp), so no rig is needed.
_styleSuffix: stylized low-poly chibi game character, oversized head, small rounded body, standing idle pose with arms relaxed, flat pastel colors, soft warm palette, cozy friendly game art, single full-body character, feet together on the ground, no base, no background, no text
